has been selected by EnEarth, a subsidiary of Energean, to supply premium tubular solutions for the first phase of the Prinos CO₂ Carbon Storage project in Greece.
The contract covers approximately 3,000 tons of casing pipes and accessories.

Located offshore Greece, Prinos CO₂ is one of Europe’s most advanced carbon storage projects. It aims to convert a depleted oil reservoir into a permanent CO₂ storage site, with a targeted injection capacity of up to 2.8 million tons per year and a total ̶ proved plus probable ̶ storage capacity of 51.5 million tons, as per NSAI’s (Netherland, Sewell & Associates, Inc.) independent Competent Person’s Report.

Under the contract, Vallourec will deliver a comprehensive package of premium tubular solutions, including seamless carbon steel and corrosion-resistant alloy casing pipes equipped with VAM premium connections, recognized for their superior sealing performance and reliability.

title: Vallourec secures contract for Greek offshore Prinos CO₂ storage project
